blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.
blocks.zh: 断断续续的自递模型,特别是通过下接的预测,已经成为现代语言模型的基石. 将这一范式扩展至视觉,可以使视觉和语言模式趋同于一个统一的框架,从而促进共享的方法和基础设施. 这部作品调查了一个中心问题:一个有限的离散词汇在代表视觉世界的丰富性方面能走多远? 我们介绍dNaViT,一种异地土著分辨率的视觉变形器,它产生类似于语言符号的离散视觉原始. dNaViT在被冷冻的预导编码器上所建,采用重量轻的剩余调制,具有双分支目标,为语义特征注入再重建-知觉提示. 通过利用被分组的产品量化,它在不夸大空间序列长度的情况下衡量离散能力,而平衡的培训配方则保持语义和像素级信息。 因此,dNaViT可以发挥多功能的离散视觉显示器的作用,在高真实度图像解码的同时,可以实现跨下游任务的统一编码。 广泛的评价表明,dNaViT在12个视觉理解基准、4个生成基准和一个图像编辑基准中匹配或超过特定任务的基线。 这些调查结果表明,紧凑的离散词汇可作为通用的可视货币,并释放充分统一、本土多式联运方法的全部潜力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models have achieved remarkable success through next-token prediction, anchored by discrete tokens as their fundamental modeling unit ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . From the perspective of compression as intelligence ( Delétang et al., 2023 ) , discrete tokens provide a unified substrate for representation learning and autoregressive modeling. In contrast, modern multimodal models frequently rely on modality-specific representations and heterogeneous learning objectives ( Caffagni et al., 2024 ) . This paradigm divergence disconnects vision from the established techniques and scalable infrastructure to language, raising a foundational question: can visual information be represented losslessly like language using a learned discrete vocabulary?
blocks.zh: 语言模型通过下接的预测取得了显著成功,以离散的符号作为基础模型单元(Brown等人,2020年)。 从压缩作为智能的视角(Delétang等,2023年)来看,离散符号为表现式学习和自相递进式建模提供了统一的底物. 相比之下,现代多式联运模式往往依赖特定模式的表述和不同的学习目标(Caffagni等,2024年)。 这种范式的分化将视觉从既定的技术和可扩展的基础设施切入语言,提出了一个基础问题:视觉信息能否像使用学习到的离散词汇的语言一样被无穷无尽地表示出?

blocks.en: Discrete visual representations offer a promising bridge, naturally aligning visual inputs with autoregressive language architectures under a unified token-prediction objective ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Zou et al., 2026b ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . However, discretizing dense, continuous visual signals into a finite vocabulary presents a severe information bottleneck ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) that hinders performance. Crucially, harmonizing high-level semantic abstraction for understanding with fine-grained pixel details for high-fidelity reconstruction within a single discrete bottleneck remains an unresolved tension ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 分明的视觉表现提供了一条充满希望的桥梁,在统一的符号预测目标下自然地将视觉输入与自递性语言架构相配合(谢等,2024;王等,2024b;邹等,2026b;彭等,2026;梅通龙卡特). Team等,2026; Cui等,2025.). 然而,将密集而连续的视觉信号编成一个有限度的词汇,呈现出严重的信息瓶颈(Ma等,2025;Yu等,2026),阻碍了性能. 关键是,将高级语义抽象统一起来,以便用精细的像素细节来理解在一个单一的离散瓶颈内进行高诚信重建的问题,这仍然是一个尚未解决的紧张关系(Wu等,2024;Qu等,2025)。

blocks.en: To answer the question posed above and address these challenges, we introduce dNaViT , a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that extends our preliminary work in LongCat-Next ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) . Following the representation encoder paradigm ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , dNaViT enriches the semantic features of a frozen pretrained encoder with pixel details through a Residual Modulator (ResMod), without compromising its underlying semantic capability. The resulting features are discretized into a shared vocabulary using Grouped Product Quantization (PQ) ( Jégou et al., 2011 ) under dual-branch representation and pixel reconstruction loss. Training progresses through continuous initialization, discrete feature alignment, and final joint optimization, which balance theses objectives and suppress gradient interference.
blocks.zh: 为了回答上述问题并应对这些挑战,我们引入了dNaViT,一种分散的土著分辨率视觉变换器,扩展了我们在LongCat-Next(Meituan LongCat Team等,2026年)的初步工作。 遵循了代表编码器范式(郑等,2025年),dNaViT通过残余模具(ResMod)来丰富被冻结的预加固编码器的语义特征,而不会损害其基本的语义能力. 由此产生的特征被用分组产品量化(PQ)(Jégou等,2011年)在双分支代表与像素重建损失下被分解为共享词汇. 培训通过持续初始化、离散特征相接和最终联合优化来取得进展,这些组合平衡了这些目标并抑制了梯度干扰。

blocks.en: These design choices yield a shared discrete interface for tasks that conventionally rely on separate visual encodings, extending the utility of pretrained representations beyond their original objectives. By rotating and translating pretrained features, residual modulation reorganizes their geometry to accommodate reconstruction-relevant information, making more effective use of the available representational capacity. Combined with sufficient factorized code capacity, this allows semantic structure and fine-grained detail to coexist within a shared discrete bottleneck, mitigating information loss during quantization. The resulting tokenizer brings the flexibility of text tokenization to vision: images can be encoded into discrete sequences and decoded into faithful reconstructions, while the codes retain semantic information closely aligned with language.
blocks.zh: 这些设计选择产生了一个共享的离散接口,用于传统上依赖于单独的视觉编码的任务,将预先训练的表示的效用扩展到了它们最初的目标之外. 通过旋转和翻译预先训练过的特征,剩余调制重新组合了它们的几何结构,以容纳与重建有关的信息,并更有效地利用现有的代表能力。 加上足够的要素化代码能力,这可以使语义结构和精细细细节在一个共享的离散瓶颈内并存,减轻了被量化过程中的信息损失. 由此而来的说明器为视觉带来了文本象征化的灵活性:图像可以被编码为离散序列并解码为忠实的重建,而代码则保留与语言紧密相通的语义信息.

blocks.en: We evaluate the generality of dNaViT across four core capabilities: image reconstruction, classification, multimodal understanding, generation, editing. Driven by a single shared discrete vocabulary with a spatial downsampling factor f = 32 f=32 , dNaViT achieves 28.12 ​ dB 28.12\text{\penalty\ dB} PSNR and 0.81 0.81 SSIM at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution without sacrificing semantic representation capability. When paired with Qwen3-8B, dNaViT surpasses prior discrete baselines and rivals Qwen3-VL-8B across key document and reasoning benchmarks, scoring 885 885 on OCRBench. For image generation and editing, dNaViT achieve impressive performance on GenEval2 ( 49.5 49.5 ) and outperforms open-weight baselines on Qwen-Image-Bench ( 52.2 52.2 ), while excelling at bilingual text rendering. Crucially, dNaViT establishes these comprehensive understanding and generation capabilities under a substantially reduced data budget relative to existing models.
blocks.zh: 我们评价dNaViT在四个核心能力方面的通用性:图像重建、分类、多模式理解、生成、编辑。 由单一共享的离散词汇所驱动,空间下标系数f=32 f=32,dNaViT实现28.12 dB 28.12\text\penalty\ dB}PSNR和0.81 0.81 SSIM在512×512 512\times 512分解时不牺牲语义表达能力. 当与Qwen3-8B配对时,dNaViT超越了先前的离散基线,并超越了关键文档和推理基准的Qwen3-VL-8B对手,在OCR Bench上得分885885. 在图像生成和编辑方面,dNaViT在GenEval2(49.5 49.5)上取得了令人印象深刻的性能,在Quen-Image-Bench(52.2 52.2)上的表现超过了开量基线,同时在双语文本渲染上表现优异. 关键是,dNaViT在与现有模型相比数据预算大幅减少的情况下建立了这些全面的理解和生成能力.

blocks.en: These findings suggest that the gap between continuous visual signals and discrete tokens is a challenge of representation learning rather than an inherent limitation. With appropriate modeling, discrete codes can serve as general-purpose visual primitives, bringing vision and language into a shared token-based paradigm. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 这些研究结果表明,连续的视觉信号与离散的符号之间的差距是对表现学习的挑战,而不是固有的限制. 通过适当的建模,离散代码可以作为通用视觉原始,将视觉和语言带入一个基于共同符号的范式. 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: 1. This work explores the question of whether discrete codes can serve as general-purpose visual primitives , analogous to the role of tokens in language modeling. To investigate this possibility, we introduce dNaViT, a native-resolution visual tokenizer designed to capture both high-level semantic structure and fine-grained pixel information within a shared vocabulary for different tasks. 2. dNaViT uses residual modulation to aggregate multi-level features from a frozen vision encoder and grouped product quantization to encode the enriched representations. Progressive training coordinates dual-branch semantic and pixel reconstruction objectives. Experiments demonstrate that this design balances semantic preservation and reconstruction fidelity within the discrete bottleneck. 3. Comprehensive evaluations across visual understanding, image reconstruction, generation, and editing demonstrate dNaViT’s generality. With a substantially smaller training data budget than the compared models, dNaViT achieves strong understanding and generation performance, highlighting the effectiveness and data efficiency of its unified, language-aligned representation. 4. This work demonstrates that a shared discrete token space can serve as a universal visual currency , providing a general-purpose intermediate representation across complementary tasks and a foundation for fully unified, native multimodal modeling.

blocks.en: 2 dNaViT
blocks.zh: 2个dNaViT

blocks.en: This section presents dNaViT, a visual tokenizer that learns shared discrete codes as a unified interface for diverse downstream tasks, replacing separate task-specific feature representations. We will describe how the architecture supports these capabilities while mitigating conflicts between semantic abstraction and fine-grained detail preservation, as well as information loss during discretization.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍dNaViT,一种可视化的表示器,它学习共享的离散代码,作为不同下游任务的统一界面,取而代之的是单独的任务特有特征表示. 我们将说明该架构如何支持这些能力,同时减轻语义抽象和精细细节保存之间的冲突,以及磁盘化过程中的信息损失。

blocks.en: 2.1 Background
blocks.zh: 2.1 背景情况

blocks.en: Visual modeling has largely relied on distinct continuous representations for different downstream tasks: pretrained semantic features for multimodal understanding ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) and reconstruction-oriented latents for diffusion-based synthesis ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) . Representation autoencoders bridge these approaches by pairing pretrained semantic encoders with reconstruction decoders ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . By contrast, language models use discrete tokens as a uniform representation of text, supporting a unified, scalable next-token prediction framework. Meanwhile, recent benchmarks ( An et al., 2026a ; Yan et al., 2026 ) highlight the growing need to integrate linguistic and visual intelligence to solve real-world tasks.
blocks.zh: 视觉建模主要依靠不同的下游任务不同的连续表示:对多式联运的理解(Tschannn等人,2025年)进行预先训练的语义特征,以及以再造为导向的扩散合成潜想(Rombach等人,2022年)。 代表自动编码器通过将预先训练的语义编码器与重建解码器配对来连接这些方法(郑等,2025年). 相形之下,语言模型使用离散符号作为文本的统一表示,支持一个统一,可伸缩的下接键预测框架. 同时,最近的基准(An等人,2026a; Yan等,2026)强调日益需要将语言和视觉智能结合起来,以解决现实世界的任务.

blocks.en: Extending this framework to vision is challenging: unlike the discrete symbols of language, visual signals encode dense, continuous variation. Discrete visual tokenization addresses this by mapping images to sequences of codebook indices. For example, vector-quantized autoencoders assign continuous features to learned codebook entries and reconstruct images from the corresponding embeddings ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ) . These indices can be embedded and predicted like text tokens, enabling a shared autoregressive interface and the reuse of language-model architectures and objectives. Chameleon ( Chameleon Team, 2024 ) and Emu3 ( Wang et al., 2024b ) demonstrate this formulation for multimodal understanding and generation. However, information loss during tokenization can constrain downstream performance and the benefits of scaling.
blocks.zh: 将这个框架扩展到视觉具有挑战性:与语言的离散符号不同,视觉信号编码密集,持续变异. discrete可视化符号化通过将图像映射到代码集索引的序列来解决这个问题. 例如,矢量化自编码器为已学习到的编码簿条目指定了连续功能并重建了从相应嵌入的图像(van den Oord等,2017.). 这些指数可以像文本符号一样被嵌入并预测,从而能够共享自递式界面并重新使用语言-模型架构和目标. Chameleon (Chameleon Team, 2024)和 Emu3 (Wang等, 2024b) 演示了这种用来多模式理解和生成的配方. 然而,象征性化过程中的信息损失会限制下游的业绩和规模化的好处.

blocks.en: A shared token interface alone does not guarantee that the learned codes jointly preserve semantic information and fine-grained visual detail, both of which are essential to general-purpose visual modeling. Prior studies have examined the distinct information requirements of understanding and reconstruction ( Qu et al., 2025 ) and identified limited discrete capacity as a key bottleneck in supporting both objectives ( Ma et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by these findings, dNaViT aims to preserve complementary task-relevant information within a shared discrete vocabulary and match the performance of task-specific representations.
blocks.zh: 仅一个共享的代号接口并不能保证所学代码共同保存语义信息和精细的视觉细节,两者对于通用视觉模型制作都是必不可少的. 以往的研究审查了理解和重建的不同信息要求(Qu等,2025年),并查明了有限的离散能力是支持这两个目标的关键瓶颈(Ma等,2025年)。 根据这些调查结果,dNaViT旨在将与任务相关的补充信息保存在一个共享的离散词汇中,并与具体任务表述的绩效相匹配。

blocks.en: 2.2 Overall Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.2 总体结构

blocks.en: Motivated by the exploration of information recovery through residual connections ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) , dNaViT further propose residual modulation to aggregate complementary cues and enrich the features of a frozen native-resolution vision encoder with reconstruction-relevant detail (Fig. 3 ). To preserve both semantic structure and visual detail within a shared discrete bottleneck, we quantize the enriched features using grouped product quantization and supervise the resulting codes through dual reconstruction branches. Progressive training coordinates these objectives to mitigate interference during optimization.
blocks.zh: 由于通过残余连接(Meituan LongCat Team等,2026年)探索信息回收的动机,dNaViT进一步提出剩余调制,以汇总互补提示并用与重建相关的细节来丰富被冻结的本土分辨率视觉编码器的特点(图3)。 为了将语义结构和视觉细节保留在一个共同的离散瓶颈内,我们使用分组产品量化法对丰富的特征进行量化,并通过双重重建分支监督由此产生的代码。 渐进培训协调这些目标,以缓解优化期间的干扰。

blocks.en: 2.3 Representation Encoder
blocks.zh: 2.3 代表编码器

blocks.en: Unified visual tokenization must reconcile appearance invariance for understanding with sensitivity to detail for reconstruction. RAEs demonstrate reconstruction from continuous semantic features ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , while LongCat-Next suggests that residual connections can carry low-level information across a semantic encoder ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) . This motivates us to directly leverage complementary cues by recombining multiple encoder depths, without even training the encoder itself. Meanwhile, quantization may collapse weakly expressed appearance differences into the same code. It therefore requires retaining the final semantic representation as an explicit anchor throughout quantization to preserve representation quality.
blocks.zh: 统一的视觉标志化必须调和外观变化以理解和对重建细节的敏感性。 RAEs从连续语义特征(Zheng等,2025年)证明了重建,而LongCat-Next则暗示了剩余连接可以携带低等信息穿过语义编码器(Meituan LongCat Team等,2026年). 这激励了我们通过重新组合多个编码器深度来直接利用互补提示,甚至没有训练编码器本身. 同时,量化可能会在表达的微弱外表差异上崩溃入同一种代码. 因此,它要求保留最后的语义代表作为整个量化过程的明确锚地,以保持代表的质量。

blocks.en:
To tackle this, we introduce a Residual Modulator (ResMod) inspired by frozen semantic base with
detail-aware modulation of PAE ( Yue et al., 2026 ) , which fuses intermediate features from

blocks.en: The residual modulator enriches the features entering the discrete bottleneck, but retaining the exposed semantic distinctions and spatial detail requires sufficient quantization capacity at each spatial position. Motivated by evidence that multi-codebook quantization with a sufficient bit budget preserves semantic information at a level competitive with continuous representations ( Zou et al., 2026a ) , we adopt grouped product quantization ( Jégou et al., 2011 ) to expand this capacity while keeping the spatial token grid unchanged. As illustrated in Fig. 4 , the features are factorized along the channel dimension and encoded using multiple codebooks, avoiding a prohibitively large monolithic vocabulary.

A general-purpose visual vocabulary must preserve pretrained semantic structure while retaining the fine-grained visual detail needed to recover the original visual signal. These requirements concern different output spaces but must be satisfied
by the same discrete codes. We therefore introduce two specialized decoders that share the quantized representation.
The semantic branch aligns the codes with continuous visual features, while the pixel branch supervises image reconstruction.

blocks.en:
Although the ViT pixel decoder preserves image content faithfully, standard practices often employ a refiner module to further enhance its visual perceptual quality. We introduce a code-conditioned Refiner for
high-fidelity decoding with sharper, more realistic details
(Fig. 6 ). Unlike conventional super-resolution models
conditioned on decoded RGB images, our Refiner directly conditions on discrete
visual codes, avoiding information loss introduced by intermediate pixel
decoding. It also requires no text conditioning, whose semantic priors may
alter source content and constrain image editing. Built on a pretrained
image-generation prior, the Refiner replaces the ViT pixel decoder with a
flow decoder using discrete codes as its sole conditioning input. We train
a multi-step teacher and distill it into an efficient one-step student.

As illustrated in Fig. 7 , training proceeds through continuous pixel pretraining, discrete semantic reconstruction, and joint reconstruction. The tokenizer combines a pretrained Qwen3-VL ViT ( ∼ \sim 400M), frozen throughout training to preserve its semantic representations, with a residual modulator ( ∼ \sim 100M), totaling ∼ \sim 500M parameters. blocks.en: 3.2 Training Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训数据

blocks.en: The tokenization and de-tokenization training corpus combines diverse image sources to support semantic representation learning and maintain fine-grained pixel information. These sources are grouped into three complementary categories according to visual content. Tokenizer training uses images exclusively for dual-branch supervision, with a carefully controlled resolution distribution to support arbitrary-resolution training.
blocks.zh: 象征化和去托肯化培训教程结合了多种图像来源,支持语义表达式学习并保持精细的像素信息. 这些来源按照视觉内容分为三个补充类别。 Tokener训练专门使用图像用于双分支监督,并有精心控制的分辨率分配,以支持任意分辨率训练.

blocks.en: LAION ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , COYO ( Byeon et al., 2022 ) , and DataComp ( Gadre et al., 2023 ) , together with images from Recap-DataComp-1B ( Li et al., 2024 ) and CapsFusion ( Yu et al., 2024b ) , provide broad coverage of objects, scenes, and visual styles. An in-house image corpus further expands the diversity of the training data.
blocks.zh: LAION (Shuhmann等, 2022年),COYO (Byeon等, 2022年),和DataComp (Gadre等, 2023年),连同Recap-DataComp-1B (Li等, 2024年)和CapsFusion (Yu等, 2024年b)的相片,广泛覆盖了物体,场景和视觉风格. 内部的成像仪进一步扩大了培训数据的多样性。

blocks.en: Selected subsets of TextAtlas5M ( Wang et al., 2025a ) include book covers, images containing long words, academic papers, and presentation slides. Chinese- and English-language book and news pages, along with additional OCR-oriented collections, extend coverage to dense text, small characters, and complex document layouts. Infographic collections and ChartGalaxy ( Li et al., 2025 ) further contribute information-dense content, including charts and tables, where spatial relationships among visual elements are critical to interpretation.
blocks.zh: TextAtlas5M 的选定子集 (Wang等,2025a.)包括图书封面,包含长词的图像,学术论文和演示幻灯片. 中文版和英文版的书籍和新闻页,加上额外的以OCR为取向的藏书,将报道范围扩大到了密集的文本,小字符,以及复杂的文档布局. 图片集和图表Galaxy(Li等,2025年)进一步提供了信息密集的内容,包括图表,其中视觉要素之间的空间关系对解释至关重要。

blocks.en: Face-focused LAION subsets, images derived from SA-1B ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) , and an in-house collection of high-aesthetic-quality images enrich the corpus with detailed facial structures, local textures, and varied image compositions.
blocks.zh: 以面相为主的LAION子集,出自SA-1B(Kirillov等,2023年)的相片,以及内部高美质量相片的集成,丰富了相片的面部结构,局部纹理,以及各种相片组成.

blocks.en: Training begins at a fixed resolution of 256 × 256 256\times 256 using a limited set of image sources to facilitate rapid convergence, then progressively transitions to native-resolution training at resolutions up to 2K on a broader data mixture. During this transition, sampling maintains a balanced distribution across resolution ranges. Images are resized to approximately preserve their aspect ratios, align spatial dimensions with the encoder stride, and keep sequence lengths within the token budget. Across all stages, the model is trained on several hundred billion tokens.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate dNaViT across five complementary tasks to assess the generality of its shared discrete representation. Image reconstruction measures the preservation of fine-grained detail, while frozen-feature classification and multimodal understanding assess semantic discriminability, transfer robustness, and visual reasoning. Autoregressive text-to-image generation and instruction-guided editing further examine the utility of the learned codes for conditional synthesis and image manipulation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价dNaViT的五个互补任务,以评估其共同分散代表性的普遍性。 图像重建衡量保存精细细节,而冷冻地貌分类和多模式理解则评估语义上的区别性,转移稳健性,以及视觉推理. 自动回转的文本到图像生成和被指导的编辑进一步审查了学习到的代码用于有条件的合成和图像操作的效用.

blocks.en: 4.1 Image Reconstruction

blocks.en: We evaluate reconstruction on ImageNet-1K ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) and TokBench ( Wu et al., 2025c ) to assess whether dNaViT’s shared discrete vocabulary preserves overall image fidelity and fine-grained textual and facial detail. We denote the dNaViT variants with 16 and 64 quantization groups as dNaViT-G16 and dNaViT-G64, respectively; both use a vision transformer (ViT) pixel decoder without refinement and a spatial downsampling factor of f = 32 f=32 . dNaViT-G16-R denotes the 16-group variant with the ViT pixel decoder replaced by the code-conditioned flow decoder (Refiner; Sec. 2.6 ). On ImageNet-1K, we report PSNR and SSIM at 256 × 256 256\times 256 , 512 × 512 512\times 512 , and 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , using the full validation set and standard preprocessing. On TokBench, we report text recognition accuracy (T-ACC), normalized edit similarity (T-NED), and face similarity (F-Sim) at 512 × 512 512\times 512 and 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , with equal weighting across the official instance-scale buckets. Baseline scores are taken from published reports. Differences in evaluation protocols and training configurations preclude controlled or rate-matched comparisons.

blocks.en: Discrete representations are often assumed to discard the fine-grained visual details required for OCR and document understanding ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . Table 6 shows that dNaViT outperforms the compared discrete models and substantially narrows the gap to strong continuous models on text-centric tasks. It performs comparably to Qwen3-VL-8B on DocVQA and OmniDocBench and leads the compared models on both CharXiv tasks. These results demonstrate that discrete visual representations can support fine-grained OCR, document understanding, and chart interpretation, challenging the view that they are inherently unsuitable for fine-grained visual tasks.

blocks.en: 5.1 Effectiveness of ResMod

blocks.en:
We compare ResMod ( a zero-initialized residual modulation module with the pretrained encoder frozen ) with SelfDistill ( a shallow fusion baseline that trains the encoder while matching its final-layer features to a frozen teacher ) Tang et al. (2025b) ; Yue et al. (2025b) .
As shown in Fig. 8 , ResMod maintains lower pixel MSE and representation cosine losses during the late training stage. The zoomed 10k–11k interval shows that both advantages remain stable rather than arising from isolated fluctuations. These results indicate that ResMod preserves high-level semantic representations while retaining more fine-grained visual details, resulting in more effective fusion of pixel and semantic information.

blocks.en: We further assess the effectiveness of ResMod on visual understanding tasks. These experiments use Qwen3-1.7B as the language backbone, with the visual tokenizer kept frozen. In Table 9 , settings 1 and 3 train understanding models on frozen continuous features without and with pretrained ResMod, respectively. For the training-free setting 2, we directly insert pretrained ResMod into the trained model from 1 at evaluation time, without any further parameter updates. Setting 2 maintains comparable average performance to 1, even without retraining the LLM. Together with the reconstruction results above, this provides further evidence that ResMod can enrich pixel-level information while preserving pretrained semantic information.

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison between Discrete and Continuous Approaches
blocks.zh: 5.2 不同做法和持续做法之间的比较

blocks.en: Using the same understanding training and evaluation setup as in Sec. 5.1 , we compare discrete and continuous visual representations. Table 9 shows comparable performance across general understanding, OCR, and document benchmarks. This observation is consistent with the scaling analysis in LongCat-Next ( Meituan LongCat Team et al., 2026 ) , which finds that discrete visual embeddings require more training data because they are learned from scratch, and that increasing the data scale progressively closes the gap with continuous models. Together, these findings suggest that discrete visual representations can match continuous features in multimodal understanding.
blocks.zh: 使用与第5.1节相同的理解培训和评价机制,我们比较了离散和连续的视觉表现。 表9显示在一般理解、OCR和文件基准方面的可比业绩。 这一观测与"长卡特-Next"(Meituan LongCat Team等,2026年)中的缩放分析一致,该分析认为离散的视觉嵌入需要更多的培训数据,因为这些数据是从零开始学习的,而增加数据尺度会用连续的模型来逐渐地缩小差距. 这些结论合在一起表明,离散的视觉表现可以匹配多式联运中的连续特征。

blocks.en: 5.4 Qualitative Visual Understanding Examples

blocks.en: We present qualitative examples of our 8B understanding model on challenging visual inputs: dense full-page documents in English (Fig. 10 ) and Chinese (Fig. 11 ), cursive handwriting (Fig. 13 ), an engineering drawing (Fig. 13 ), and diagram-grounded reasoning (Figs. 15 and 15 ). Each example places the source image inside the model response, with the instruction and the response set. Responses are reproduced verbatim, including the model’s own errors. Long transcriptions are truncated at a paragraph boundary and marked as continuing, and for examples in which the model produces an explicit reasoning trace, only the final response is shown. These examples illustrate fine-grained recognition and reasoning rather than replace quantitative evaluation.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work presents dNaViT, a foundational visual component acting as a native-resolution tokenizer that turns discrete codes into universal visual primitives. Through lightweight residual modulation, grouped product quantization, and progressive dual-branch optimization, dNaViT successfully reconciles high-level semantic abstraction with fine-grained visual reconstruction. Further code-conditioned refinement enhances perceptual fidelity without altering the unified representation. Across understanding, generation, and editing tasks, dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines under a significantly smaller data budget. These findings demonstrate that a shared discrete token space can serve as a universal visual currency, paving the way for fully unified, native multimodal intelligence.
blocks.zh: 这部作品呈现了dNaViT,一个基础视觉组件,起到本土分辨率的活化器的作用,将离散代码转化为通用视觉原始. dNaViT通过轻量级剩余调制,分组产品量化,并渐进双分支优化,将高层次的语义抽象与精细的外观重建成功调和. 进一步的有编码条件的完善可以增强观念上的忠诚而不会改变统一代表制. dNaViT在整个理解、生成和编辑任务中,匹配或超过数据预算显著减少的特定任务的基线。 这些调查结果表明,共享的离散符号空间可以作为通用的视觉货币,为完全统一、本土的多模式智能铺平道路。

blocks.en: we encamped on the shore, opposite a very remarkable rock in the lake, which had attracted our attention for many miles. It rose, according to our estimate, 600 feet above the water, and, from the point we viewed it, presented a pretty exact outline of the great pyramid of Cheops. Like other rocks along the shore, it seemed to be encrusted with calcareous cement. This striking feature suggested a name for the lake, and I called it Pyramid Lake; and, though it may be deemed by some a fanciful resemblance, I can undertake to say that the future traveller will find a much more striking resemblance between this rock and the Pyramids of Egypt than there is between them and the object from which they take their name.
blocks.zh: 我们在岸上安营扎寨,对面是湖中的一块非常出众的岩石, 它吸引了我们许多英里的注意力。 据我们估计,它上升了600英尺, 在水面上, 从我们所看到的这一点来看, 它是一个非常精确的 勾克斯大金字塔的轮廓。 和岸上的其他岩石一样,它似乎被卡路里水泥所缠绕. 这个引人注目的地物为这个湖取了个名字,我称之为"金字塔湖"(Pyramid Lake;虽然它可能被一些幻想的相似性所认为),但我可以承诺,未来的旅行者将会发现这个岩石和埃及金字塔之间的相似性比它们和它们取名的对象之间的相似性要高得多。

摘要：通过测定土壤水文物理性质、持水及渗透性能，分析了小兴安岭南麓典型森林土壤的持水、蓄水和渗透能力，并利用 Kostiakov 方程、Horton 方程和 Philip 方程模拟了土壤入渗过程。结果表明：该区森林土壤容重介于 0.45～1.52 g/cm 3 之间；不同植被类型饱和含水率为 28.73%～177.32%，毛管含水率 25.26～156.84%，自然含水率 13.91%～119.18%，随着土层深度加厚，三者具有明显减小趋势；土壤最大持水量范围为 282.88～341.41 mm，有效持水量为 27.88～61.13 mm，涵蓄降水能力为 165.98～197.37 mm（除人工兴安落叶松林为 76.32 mm 以外）；各植被类型土壤初渗速率和稳渗速率最大值在 0—10 cm 或 10—20 cm 土层，平均值分别为 11.92 mm/min 和 2.78 mm/min，二者最小值在不同的植被类型下出现的土层不同，平均值分别为 2.19 mm/min 和 0.66 mm/min；从土壤的入渗过程模拟看，Horton 方程的模拟效果较好。
关键词：土壤水文物理；持水能力；渗透性；小兴安岭

blocks.en: Abstract:Based on soil hydrology physical properties, water holding capacity and infiltration, the water storage and infiltration capacity were analyzed in typical forest stands in down south of Xiaoxing’an Mountains, and Kostiakov equation, Horton equation and Philip equation were used to simulate the soil infiltration processes. The results showed that soil bulk density was between 0.45～1.52 g/cm 3 , and soil saturated moisture contents of different vegetation types were between 28.73%～177.32%, capillary moisture contents were 25.26%～156.84%, the natural moisture contents were 13.91%～119.18%, and these three parameters obviously decreased with increase of soil depth; the range of soil maximum storage capacity was 282.88～341.41 mm, effective capacity was 27.88～61.13 mm, retention ability of precipitation was 165.98～197.37 mm (except for artificial Larix gmelini forest of 76.32 mm). Soil initial infiltration rate and steady infiltration rate of each vegetation type were the largest in 0—10 cm or 10—20 cm soil layer, the average value was 11.92 mm/min and 2.78 mm/min, respectively, and their minimum values in different vegetation types present in different soil layers, with average value of 2.19 mm/min and 0.66 mm/min. According to the soil infiltration process simulation, Horton equation was better for this simulation.
blocks.zh: 摘要:根据土壤水文物理特性、蓄水能力和渗入能力,在小青山以南的典型林地上分析了蓄水和渗入能力,Kostiakov方程、Horton方程和Philip方程被用来模拟土壤渗入过程。 结果显示,土壤体积密度为0.45-1.52克/立方厘米;不同植被类型的土壤饱和水分含量为28.73-177.32%;毛细水分含量为25.26-156.84%;天然水分含量为13.91-119.18%;这三项参数随着土壤深度的增大而明显减少;土壤最大储存容量为282.88-341.41毫米;有效容量为27.88-61.13毫米;降水保留能力为165.98-197.37毫米(人工拉里克格梅利尼森林为76.32毫米除外)。 每种植被类型的土壤初始渗透率和稳定的渗透率在0-10厘米或10-20厘米土壤层中是最大的,平均值分别为11.92毫米/分和2.78毫米/分,其在不同土壤层中存在的不同植被类型的最低值为2.19毫米/分和0.66毫米/分. 根据土壤渗透过程模拟,霍顿方程更适合这种模拟.
